newsitem.title: USA: Babbitt says no decision yet on NPRA leasing.
newsitem.headline: Babbitt says no decision yet on NPRA leasing.

text.p: Following a four-day trip to Alaska's North Slope, Interior Secretary Bruce Babbitt said Friday he is undecided on whether a vast federal reserve should be open to oil leasing or preserved from development.
It is too early to determine the fate of the National Petroleum Reserve-Alaska, a 23 million-acre federal property west of the Prudhoe Bay oil complex, Babbitt said at a news conference.
The Interior Department has selected the reserve's northeast corner, encompassing 4.6 million acres, as a study area for possible oil and gas leasing

The spread of oil development across the North Slope -- and especially the recent discovery of a large oil field on the reserve's eastern border -- makes a new look at the reserve leasing timely, Babbitt said.
According to some estimates, the ground below the petroleum reserve could hold up to 5 billion barrels of recoverable oil.
